full_judgment:
The pre-emptee petitioners appeared and filed an application for rejection of the pre-emption application on 19.10.2010 on two gr5ound namely the case land is Industrial plot and therefore the case was not maintainable under section 96 of the Act, 1950 the pre- emptee also filed written objection on 11-09-2011 raising objection inter alia that the pre-emptor has not complied with the provision of section 96(3) as amended by the State Acquisition and Tenancy amendment Act, 2006 which requires deposit of 25% consideration as consideration and the additional 8% as interest. 

 On perusal of the materials on record it appears that the admittedly transfer document was executed and registered on 7.9.2006  i.e.  before commencement  of  State  Acquisition  and 

 Tenancy Amendment Act, 2006 which published in the Gazette on 20.9.2006. The	section 1(2)	of this	Act provides Which means Law came into force on 20.9.2006. 

 “Nothing in this section shall apply to any transfer of any proton or share of holding of a raiyat or any application under section 96 of this Act, made prior to coming into force of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Amendment Act, 2006.”
